cards.name: Previous - Orange
cards.summary: Symbol 'Previous - Orange' from Illustrator's Mobile symbol library: a glossy round button, golden yellow brightening to pale yellow near the bottom, with a darker amber rim and a faint amber drop shadow under the glyph, holding a black skip-back symbol: a vertical bar at the left of a solid triangle pointing left. The name says Orange, but the picture is gold-yellow and amber rather than a true orange; the picture wins. (Thumbnail: one instance placed from the library and fitted to 300 pt on white, applied by script; natural size about 64 x 64 pt; not a shipped preview.)
avoid: a labelled button: the icon has no text; add the label beside it with the Type tool
a plain back arrow: this is a skip-to-start media symbol; use the Arrow Left button for a simple left arrow
a calm neutral look: the gold-yellow button is loud; use the Grey version for secondary buttons
a flat or modern look: the glossy bevel is baked in; break the link and set flat fills for a flat UI
cards.applies_to: the artboard of an open document: placing it creates a symbol instance, a linked copy of the symbol definition that can be moved, scaled and rotated like any object; the symbol must exist in the target document (placing from the library copies it in)
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Symbol Libraries > Mobile; click the symbol (it is added to the Symbols panel), then drag it onto the artboard or press Place Symbol Instance. Script: doc.symbolItems.add(doc.symbols.getByName("Previous - Orange")) in a document that holds the symbol; to use it in another document: app.open("<Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Symbols/Mobile.ai"), place an instance there, item.duplicate(target.layers[0], ElementPlacement.PLACEATEND) (the symbol arrives in the target document), then close the library with SaveOptions.DONOTSAVECHANGES.

verified.note: Gold-yellow glossy button (hue about 45 degrees, amber rim), not true orange, with a black skip-back bar and triangle, as described.
